metadata.name: Scribble Clock
metadata.description: A seconds counter where each numeral is left blank and a single white pen line scribbles itself around it, loop over loop, tight or loose, then lets go for the next digit. More like this, plus a designer your coding agent can use, at studios.lou15.com/?ref=21st
metadata.author: louisstudios
